Intended inversion, not lost precision: for a positive tick `type(uint256).max / price` inverts the Q128.128 ratio exactly as Uniswap v4-core TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick does (Slither pairs it with the table products above it on the same variable); the result is rounded up to Q64.96 afterwards. Covered by TEST-279 (tickBoundsMatchUniswap, tickAtSqrtRatioInvertsSqrtRatioAtTick) and the TEST-037 differential suite (tickMapMatchesReference).
accepted.review: Replaces a2b58ce48cdc5468 (ClPriceMath.sqrtRatioAtTick, approved Josue 2026-11-10 by pattern): the tick math moved into the MIT ClTickMath (v4-core TickMath), which ClPriceMath.sqrtRatioAtTick now calls.

accepted.reason: MarketRegistry.recordBreach(marketId, CONFIG_DRIFT) once per Active or Offboarding market of the Spoke, the permissionless breach record of REQ-RISK-090; the loop length is the Spoke's markets, which only timelock listings grow, and recordBreach (callable only by the RiskModule) makes no external call. One memory-safe mstore in _payload sets the length of the batch's own parameter array, allocated at capacity 10 or 5, to the number of actions pushed, so modifyLiquidities gets one parameter per action. It only shortens the array and never grows it. Measured 2026-11-15: copying into an exact-size array gave 23,644 bytes and sizing each batch from the PoolKey gave 23,607, both inside the 1,024-byte EIP-170 margin; with the mstore the LPVault is 23,509 bytes. Covered by the UniswapV4Integration unit tests of unwind, release, collectFees, the native ETH leg and the V4-01 fallback, and by the v4 removal and whole-account seizure gas tests.
